newsitem.title: USA: USDA invites Market Access Program applications.
newsitem.headline: USDA invites Market Access Program applications.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department Friday invited applications to participate in its Market Access Program (MAP) during fiscal year 1997.

The program promotes the development, maintenance, and expansion of commercial export markets for U.S. farm goods through cost-share assistance to eligible trade organizations that implement a foreign market development program.
The MAP is funded at $90 million annually through 2002.
USDA said all applications must be received by 1700 EDT/2100 GMT on December 16.

"I want to encourage all eligible entities to apply -- we believe funding from MAP can make a positive contribution to participants' efforts to export their products...", Agriculture Secretary Dan Glickman said in a statement.
He noted the program is well-suited for firms interested in selling consumer food products, a fast-growing market which accounted for 63 percent of the total increase in U.S. exports since 1990.

To participate applicants must be a nonprofit U.S. agricultural trade organization, nonprofit state regional trade group, agricultural cooperative, state agency or other small-sized commercial entity.
